drawbridgeConcept: Use case: stylized-concept. Input is the actual Castle Greyhaven gate and drawbridge in Wildbound. Use it as a design brief for the same old hinged timber drawbridge deck seen in the lower center. Isolate ONLY the movable deck as one antique medieval castle prop for a pixel-art game. A nearly square, broad, low slab, made from dark smoke-oak planks laid across the walking direction with very dark plank joins, muted wet oak and grey aged iron corner shoes. Two thick parallel charcoal iron straps run along the long walking direction near the side edges, with a few subtle hammered brass-gray rivets. A crosswise dark hinge plate is integrated at the near end, and a narrow iron end cap is at the far end. Make it look well used, with deliberate warm wood grain clusters and slate blue-black iron. Show the deck alone in a single informative three-quarter product concept view against flat muted charcoal. Keep the exact role and silhouette legible. No surrounding castle, scenery, chains, lights, separate pieces, people, lettering, panels, or callouts.
drawbridgeOrthographic: Use case: style-transfer. Convert the attached Castle Greyhaven drawbridge concept into one technical 1-by-4 ultra-wide orthographic pixel art sheet for sprite stacking. Four isolated drawings in this exact order, each centered in its own quarter of the same horizontal row with generous pure white separation: TOP DOWN, LEFT SIDE, FRONT, BACK. First quarter: strict perpendicular TOP DOWN, perfectly square or slightly taller than wide, edges horizontal and vertical. The thick black metal hinge bar is at the top (north end), less prominent iron cap at the bottom (front/south). Show about 12 rough-hewn dark oak planks forming horizontal parallel courses, thin dark grout and occasional broad muted brown highlights, two slate-charcoal iron straps running vertically near the side borders with small warm desaturated rivets. Other three quarters: strictly orthographic edge elevations of the exact slab, no top surface visible, each as wide as the top view and roughly one eighth as tall. Left side elevation extends left-to-right, front points left. Show the actual integrated thickness, dark oak body and aged iron end shoes. Edges can step by a single pixel at corner plates. No loose props, chains, shadows, text, captions, labels or border lines. Flat uniform white #ffffff background, no gray at all. Hard-edged true game pixel look, chunky consistent pixel grid about 80 by 81 for the top plan, non-dithered 4-tone wood and iron ramps, no perspective or tilt anywhere. Everything must be isolated and fully visible.
